run_s2spect_preprocessing: run the speech to speech spectrogram data preprocessing script with source and target audio directories
prepare_target_data: prepare target audio data by extracting log-mel spectrogram features and packing them into a zip archive
process_manifests: process source and target audio pairs across data splits to generate TSV manifest files
extract_logmel_spectrogram: extract log-mel spectrogram features from target audio waveforms with configurable FFT and mel parameters
gen_config_yaml: generate a config YAML file with spectrogram feature parameters and data augmentation settings
